contract.form: TREC One to Four Family Residential Contract (Resale)
contract.effective_date_source: Executed date on page 9, completed by the buyer's agent

deadlines.label: Earnest Money and Option Fee Delivered
deadlines.action: Deliver $5,250 earnest money and $300 option fee to Lone Star Title
deadlines.if_missed: Seller may terminate; option not granted

deadlines.label: Option Period Ends
deadlines.action: Deliver notice of termination before 5:00 PM if not proceeding
deadlines.if_missed: Unrestricted right to terminate ends; option fee kept by seller

deadlines.label: Buyer Approval (Third Party Financing Addendum) Ends
deadlines.action: Give notice of termination if buyer approval isn't obtained
deadlines.if_missed: Contract is no longer subject to buyer approval

deadlines.label: Title Commitment Delivered
deadlines.action: Title company delivers commitment and exception documents

flags: Option period ends at 5:00 PM local time per Para. 5B
